description: Twelve trigger-to-gate lines. A trigger on a line starts its DELAY in seconds, and at the end of that a gate lasting its DURATION, with a pulse at each end of the gate

params.text: Triggers all twelve lines at once
Arms that line; a line that is not armed does not answer its trigger
One shot mode: each line answers one trigger and no more
Makes that line repeat instead of firing once
Makes all twelve lines repeat instead of firing once

inputs.text: A pulse triggers all twelve lines at once
A pulse arms or disarms that line
A pulse resets all twelve lines

outputs.text: The gate for that line, starting when its DELAY has run out and lasting its DURATION
A pulse at the moment that line's gate begins
A pulse at the moment that line's gate ends
High while any of the twelve lines has its gate high
A pulse whenever any of the twelve lines begins its gate, so the whole set arrives on one cable
A pulse whenever any of the twelve lines ends its gate, so the whole set arrives on one cable

notes: each line's DELAY and DURATION are figures printed on the panel rather than knobs
a clock at the clock input makes DELAY and DURATION read as multiples of the time between clock pulses rather than as seconds
against a 500ms clock, a DELAY figure of 0.5 gives 250ms
each line's DELAY and DURATION figures are set by dragging them, from 1ms to 999.999 seconds
the probability figure beside a DELAY or DURATION, 0.0 to 1.0, spreads that time around the set value at random
menu: Use Text Fields — turns the DELAY and DURATION figures into fields that can be typed into
WONKINESS Recover — evens out the randomness put on the DELAY and DURATION times, so that across a set number of loops the total time comes back to the programmed total
LOOP count to Integrality — how many loops the recovery is measured across: 2 Loops, 4 Loops, 8 Loops, 16 Loops or 32 Loops
